purpose: Append the generated HMAC accept_token to the proposal acceptance URL without replacing the existing proposal URL construction logic.

node.name: Security - Append HMAC Token to Accept URL
node.notes: Phase 3.0.1.2. Place after 3.0.1.1 and before email/template rendering. If the existing field has a different name, map it into accept_url_base before this node.

implementation_notes: This is a node-level patch, not a replacement of Module 2.4 or 2.5.
The existing proposal acceptance URL should remain the base URL.
The signed token is URL-encoded before being appended as accept_token.
Do not expose PROPOSAL_ACCEPT_HMAC_SECRET in the URL or email payload.
test_cases: Base URL without query string produces ?accept_token=...
Base URL with existing query string produces &accept_token=...
